brief:
Nicaragua pressed the International Court of Justice to dismiss German objections to its lawsuit accusing Berlin of complicity in Israel's genocide, Middle East Eye reported. Managua argued that Germany has failed to meet its own legal obligations to prevent genocide and other grave international crimes under international law. The country urged judges to reject Berlin's defense arguments and proceed with the case.

Nicaragua's complaint centers on allegations that Germany has provided military and political support to Israel while failing to uphold its duties as a signatory to the Genocide Convention. The case represents an effort to hold third countries accountable for their role in the conflict through international legal mechanisms.
